CBBC Pirate Week Voice

I went to London for this CBBC Pirate Week Voice.

Check out the video

I'd not yet been to the new Broadcast Centre for the BBC. What a great building and set up! Such amazing studios and I was using exactly the same mic as I do in my own studio. The Neumann U87. CBBC ran Pirate Week on television and as a new daddy to my adorable daughter, the chance of working with CBBC was an easy decision in saying yes. Note: I've since gone on to provide the voice of Santa for the Cbeebies' show GoJetters!

CBBC Pirate Week Voice


I do get asked for my Pirate voice quite a lot in all fairness. Since my Lego Pirates trailer, Pop up Pirate and various other projects. With a few good pirate voiceovers in the bank, I find that I seem to be right at the front of the queue when someone is looking for a top quality pirate voice!

Get in touch

Do you have a promo, presentation or a product and you need a voice for it? Maybe like this CBBC Pirate Week Voice. Please get in touch. To make the process even easier, just let me know the intended usage of the production to quote you more accurately. Send a short sample of the script and I'll send you a short audition. This way you can check if my voice is right for your show or project.
